Method of Attack: Trojanized SolarWinds Orion binaries with malicious code to install a backdoor
Backdoor installation via compromised binaries distributed through SolarWinds auto-update mechanism
Impacted Systems: Approximately 18,000 SolarWinds customers including numerous US government agencies
Attack Vector: Compromised SolarWinds Orion binaries distributed via SolarWinds auto-update mechanism
Indicators of Compromise: Backdoor known as Solorigate (Microsoft) or SUNBURST (FireEye)
